messages:
alex_chang: Quick sync — a partner asked for a lightweight Terraform accelerator they can fork and publish to the cloud marketplaces. Requirements: AWS/GCP templates, AMI/container options, arm/x86 variants, marketplace listing artifacts, and a small CI smoke test. Any immediate blockers?

maya_ng: Sounds good. We'll need a marketplace checklist (billing ids, screenshots, listing text, support contact, license). Also legal needs to review the listing copy before we hand to partners.

sam_keller: From infra side: main work is producing example images (container and AMI) and sizing guidelines + ALB/target group examples. Also need sample autoscaling policy and expected QPS per instance. I can draft the module inputs and defaults.

linh_tran: I'll own the smoke/e2e tests and GH Actions workflow. Proposal: a tiny litmus test that 1) deploys infra with minimal params, 2) hits /health and 1 sample inference endpoint, 3) tears down. Keeps partner CI simple and fast (<10m).

devrel_bot: repo created: terraform-partner-accelerator (private) — invited: @alex_chang, @maya_ng, @sam_keller, @linh_tran. Issue templates and CODEOWNERS scaffolded. ✅

juan_santos: Important for partners doing private deployments: include a VPC example, KMS/HSM integration notes, and a section explaining Dedicated vs Hosted routing (how to pin model versions and fallbacks). Also include a short security checklist for compliance customers.

alex_chang: Can we include a minimal usage snippet in the README so partners can copy/paste? Something like:

````terraform
module "redwood_accel" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/terraform-partner-accelerator//aws"

  cluster_name = "partner-demo"
  instance_type = "c6i.large" # arm or x86 variants via variable
  model_version = "redwood/llama-3-70b"
}
````

sam_keller: Nice. I'll turn that into a more complete example with variables.tf + outputs and an example values file (arm/x86) and a small note on quantization-friendly instance sizing.

maya_ng: Timeline proposal: draft modules + README by next Wednesday, marketplace checklist + legal copy by Friday. Who can own the public docs and partner handoff?

linh_tran: I'll open the initial PR for the smoke test + GH Actions by Tuesday.

alex_chang: Great. I'll collate the marketplace checklist and assign the handoff. @devrel_bot please add project tasks to the Partnerships board.

devrel_bot: Task created: PART-457 - terraform-partner-accelerator draft + smoke tests. Due 2026-03-31. Assigned: sam_keller, linh_tran, maya_ng, alex_chang.
